verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly support fully local, no-cloud operation: open source engine runnable locally or on own stack 'free, forever', Docker self-host, local UI with no account required, and a CLI demo mode running 'with no API key and no embedding provider, on a machine with no network access,' confirming true offline/embedded capability.
